module "T_SampleSpellings.dss"

product 0 Material "M_SampleSpellings" backend=Graph
  %0 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L17:C17 "UV"
  %1 = TextureParameter(ParameterName="Tex", SortPriority=0) : Texture2D @L13:C1 "Tex"
  %2 = TextureSample(%1, %0, _, _) : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L18:C20 "Plain"
  %3 = TextureSample(%1, %0, %1, _) : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L19:C26 "WithSampler"
  %4 = Constant(Value=(0)) : float @L21:C44 "WithLevel"
  %5 = TextureSample(%1, %0, _, %4, MipValueMode="MipLevel") : [RGBA:float4, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float] @L21:C24 "WithLevel"
  %6 = Add(%2, %3) : float4 @L22:C24 "EmissiveColor"
  %7 = Add(%6, %3) : float4 @L22:C24 "EmissiveColor"
  %8 = Add(%7, %5) : float4 @L22:C24 "EmissiveColor"
  %9 = Swizzle(%8, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L22:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %10 = Swizzle(%2, Mask="w") : float @L23:C17 "Opacity"
  %11 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%9, Opacity=%10) @L15:C1
  sink %11
